market_question: Will West Ham be relegated from the English Premier League after the 2025–26 season?
reasoning: West Ham are a well-established mid-table Premier League club with strong financial backing and a squad that has competed in Europe recently. Historical relegation probabilities for such clubs are well below 15%. The market’s 34.5% implied chance is likely an overreaction to managerial changes or off-field matters. At 12% true probability, No offers significant value.
evidence_points: West Ham have not been relegated since 2011 and have consistently finished between 6th and 14th in recent seasons
The club’s wage bill and transfer spending are in the top half of the Premier League, typical of a stable top-flight side
Typical pre-season relegation odds for clubs of West Ham’s stature are in the 5–15% range, not 30%+
sources_consulted: Historical relegation betting data from odds comparison sites
